question: A complete set of nuclear DNA in an organism is called____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Genome**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The genome is the entire set of DNA instructions found in a cell.
 
• In humans, the genome consists of 23 pairs of chromosomes located in the cell’s nucleus, as well as a small chromosome in the cell’s mitochondria.
 
• A genome contains all the information needed for an individual to develop and function.
 
• DNA is the information molecule for all living organisms.
 
• All of the DNA of an organism is called its genome.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Tissue**

 
• The Epithelium is one of the four basic types of animal tissue, along with **connective tissue, muscle tissue and nervous tissue.** 
 
• It is a thin, continuous, protective** layer of cells.**

**Chromosome**

 
• Chromosomes are thread-like structures made of **DNA and protein, **found in the nucleus of cells.
 
• They carry genetic information essential for inheritance, development, and function.
 
• Humans have** 46 chromosomes,** arranged in** 23 pairs.** Of these,** 22 are autosomes**, and **one pair is the sex chromosomes** (XX for females and XY for males).
 
• Chromosomes organize **long strands of DNA** into compact structures, ensuring efficient packaging and proper distribution during cell division (mitosis and meiosis).
 
• Chromosomes ensure that **genetic material **is passed from** parents to offspring,** influencing traits, development, and susceptibility to genetic disorders.

**Organelle**

 
• Organelles are specialized structures within a cell that perform specific functions vital to the cell's **survival and operation**.
 
• Common organelles include the nucleus (controls cell activity), mitochondria (produce energy), and ribosomes (protein synthesis).
 
• Organelles are primarily found in **eukaryotic cells**, which have membrane-bound compartments, **unlike prokaryotic cells.**
